task: Leg 7 part 1: re-derive the Array Scanning Method cost rules in this repository and pick M per waist; pure arithmetic, no FDTD
tolerance_basis: Registered reconstruction tolerance for the ASM sum: relative L2 error over the beam, 1 percent. It is the same order as the reference project's second tolerance in its own feasibility sweep, and it is the number this leg must meet before any Bloch campaign is launched.
budget_note: Affordability bound for part 2, in Bloch runs per waist. A waist needing more than this is reported as not affordable at this budget rather than silently dropped.
